Main.cls::ModuleVersion.behavior: new version from bump/explicit/modifiers; refused unless strictly higher; validated; saved and manifest rewritten in one transaction (MV1-MV9)

General/SemanticVersion.cls::WithBumpMaj.behavior: major+1, minor and patch 0, no prerelease or build (MV8, B1)

General/SemanticVersion.cls::WithBumpPat.behavior: patch+1, prerelease and build cleared (MV4, B1)

General/SemanticVersion.cls::WithPrerele.behavior: replaces the prerelease, keeps the build (B1)

General/SemanticVersion.cls::WithBuild.behavior: replaces the build, keeps the prerelease (MV4, B1)

StudioDocument/Module.cls::UpdateVersion.behavior: rewrites <Version> of the stored .ZPM document; the file on disk is untouched (MV, MV10)

Repo/Filesystem/Definition.cls::BuildCac.behavior: locks an existing repository, purges and rebuilds its cache in one transaction; any failure rolls back (LK2, LK3, TR7)

Repo/Filesystem/Definition.cls::AddCache.behavior: an unparseable manifest is skipped; a manifest whose save fails (invalid name) fails the build (LK1, TR7)

Repo/Filesystem/Definition.cls::ScanDire.behavior: Depth limits how far below the root manifests are found (D.setup)

Utils/LockManager.cls::%OnNew.behavior: release on close is immediate by default, even inside an open transaction (LK5)

Utils/LockManager.cls::LockClassId.behavior: takes the object lock; another holder makes it fail after the timeout (LK2)

Utils/LockManager.cls::UnlockAll.behavior: releases every held name and object lock (LK4)

Main.cls::UpdateLanguageExtensionsOne.behavior: replaces only the generated block, keeps user lines, appends the block once if absent (LE1, LE2, LE3)
